newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: George Town proposes rights issue.
newsitem.headline: George Town proposes rights issue.

text.p: George Town Holdings Bhd said on Friday it is proposing a five-for-two rights issue to raise 552.8 million ringgit for the development and acquisition of properties.
The issue price of the new shares will be 1.80 ringgit per share on the basis of five new shares for every two existing ones held by shareholders, George Town said in a statement.
George Town's businesses include supermarkets, department stores and trading in pharmaceutical products.
The company said the proposal had been submitted to the Securities Commission. It is seeking the listing and quotation for 307.13 million new shares in the issue.

Among the projects the rights issue will finance is the refurbishment of the Leavensden Studios north of London. The studio project includes the development of a studio tour and a family entertainment centre.

The rights issue will also be used to finance the previously announced acquisitions of Banque Financiere de la Cite S.A. in Switzerland and BFC Bank (Cayman) Ltd of the Cayman Islands, George Town said.
